title: FilmGraph Model Manifest
description: Declares a model's identity, the graph data it is allowed to read, and whether it may access the network. FilmOS enforces these declarations at runtime.

requires.description: The node and edge types this model is permitted to read. FilmOS pre-filters the graph to exactly these types before invoking the model.

network_access.description: Default false. A model with this false cannot make outbound network calls during execution (enforced at runtime). Setting true prompts the filmmaker for approval at install time.

parameters.description: Free-form tunable parameters (e.g. feature weights for a scoring function).
